snippet.title: map editor | Prego Wars devlog #4
snippet.description:
I'm probably not going to be paying rent again for this warehouse

Wishlist Prego Wars: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3085060/Prego_Wars/
Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/ZY7DX958pe

Map editors have always been around with varying degrees of user-friendliness in games. I'm taking inspiration from some of my favorites of all time (the FOATs) and adding my IDEAL map editor to my game with multiplayer and live testing support. It's gonna be insane, but first... I had to tear out the old system and rethink some pretty glaring issues.

Hopefully the map editor will be done by the end of this month! See y'all then!

#indiedev #indiegame #fps #gamedev #unity3d
